verification.method: Read-only GameAssembly disassembly; original game never executed
verification.independentClrCheck: Installed CLR Array.Sort with all-equal comparator and 17 distinct IDs produced 0,14,13,12,11,10,9,15,8,6,5,4,3,2,1,7,16. This supplements assembly, not original-game parity.

findings: Priority is signed byte descending, no X tie breaker. CLR introsort threshold 16 changes equal-item order above threshold.
X comparator wraps signed 64-bit subtraction; positive direction highest X first, nonpositive lowest first.
Active enumeration is physical occupied slots, primary then secondary; deleted slots reuse LIFO. Disabled flag bit 0 filters after enumeration.
splitSpace copies all active entries; descriptor updates preserve current order.
Morton different-depth candidate check compares only two low bits, preserving coarse false positives.
Inclusive far rectangle corner and negative/outside grid become root descriptor. FP reciprocal multiplication, not float cell division.
scanCandidates checks each pair live; host callbacks may mutate descriptors affecting later pairs.
unresolved: Dictionary growth/rebucket is refused. Scene live limit 90 per dictionary means no growth with capacity >=90.
Host must supply exact Collision.GetRect scaled local rectangle and position raws, populate collision payload, and connect scene/map/rect/inertia callbacks.
Pure helpers are not registered into shared runtime; no standalone stage simulation or original-game execution performed.
Host removal adapter must perform Collision.Dispose before storage unlink; pure storage helper handles dictionary bookkeeping only.

integration.buildChunk: Call once from current storage at native checkChunk entry; priority-sort happens once.
integration.updateDescriptors: Call after position changes with collision lookup; mutates same array slots without reorder.
integration.scanCandidates: Call in current sorted order; callback must perform native resolution and descriptor refresh before returning where native does so.
integration.storage: createStorage() uses native capacity97; createCollision(storage,resolvedPayload), removeCollision(storage,id). Explicit capacity override remains available for host verified storage snapshots.
